title: Annapolis Valley Experience Small Group Full Day Tour
includes: Free access to Grand-Pré’s Victorian gardens and exterior grounds, provided by Parks Canada
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Our tours are restricted to guests aged 16 and over. Additionally, guests must be 19 years of age or older to participate in wine sampling (at own expense) at Luckett Vineyards (bring ID!). Guests under 19 may attend the stop but will not be permitted to consume alcohol.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the breathtaking beauty of Nova Scotia’s Annapolis Valley on this unforgettable small-group, full-day tour from Halifax! Hop onboard a minivan as you visit Luckett Vineyards, Blomidon Look-Off, Halls Harbour—famous for the Bay of Fundy’s world‑highest tides, and Grand-Pré National Historic Site, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that commemorates the Acadian people and their history.

Our friendly local guides are like exploring with friends or family—approachable, passionate about Nova Scotia, and happy to share their insider knowledge. They make your day relaxed, personal, and full of little local insights, so you can enjoy every stop with ease. All stops are free-time for you to explore at your own pace. Our tour is limited to a small group of up to 5 guests—please expect minivan seating. Whether you’re looking for adventure, relaxation, or new connections, joining our Annapolis Valley Experience tour is the perfect way to experience Nova Scotia’s Annapolis Valley.
